summary: Iteration 16 — Verified Supabase-first billing refactor. Backend: all three legacy Stripe routes (/api/stripe/create-checkout, /api/webhook/stripe, /api/stripe/checkout-status/{id}) correctly return 404, /api/stripe/payments/count still returns 200 with count>=127, /api/chat/message and /api/admin/chat/insights still work, no supabase_admin/emergentintegrations import errors in supervisor logs. Frontend: Hero CTA + Navbar 'Comenzar' both open PlatformAccessScreen; both Quantro OS and Quantro Flow platform cards are rendered as ACTIVE (no 'Próximamente', not disabled); picking a platform while signed-out transitions to auth-form; 13 landing <section> elements render; announcement banner + sticky navbar present; ?checkout=cancel shows 'Pago cancelado' state; ?checkout=success shows polling modal ('Verificando tu pago…' / 'Sincronizando tu plan con Supabase…') and ZERO calls to /api/stripe/checkout-status are issued. Static verification confirms stripe.js targets https://ukootpnechabpmwsmxsi.supabase.co/functions/v1/create-checkout-session with body {priceId, successUrl, cancelUrl, locale, customerEmail}; all 6 STRIPE_PRICE_IDS in platformRoutes.js match the user-provided values exactly; usePlan.js queries ai_usage via supabase.from('ai_usage').select('type, count').eq('user_id', userId).eq('month', 'YYYY-MM') and SUMs by type, returning {agent_runs:0, ai_requests:0, automations:0} when no session.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe.js sends Authorization: Bearer <anon_key> when no session token is available; the Supabase Edge Function must accept either session JWT or anon to avoid 401 on unauthenticated flows. In practice checkout is only reachable after auth (PlatformAccessScreen gates choose_plan behind a session), so this is defensive only — but worth an explicit guard in stripe.js to refuse to fire without a session token, saving a round-trip.

PaymentReturnModal polls every 1.5s × 12 = 18s max. If Stripe webhook → Supabase profile propagation is slower (cold start), users see 'We're verifying your payment'. Consider exposing a manual 'Check again' button in the error state instead of only 'Close'.

usePlan.js fetchUsage catches any error and resets usage to zero. This is correct for UX but silently masks RLS misconfig on ai_usage; add a single console.warn with error.code (already done via console.warn(error.message)) — OK as-is.

server.py no longer imports supabase_admin / emergentintegrations — confirmed clean. The remaining /api/stripe/payments/count endpoint hard-codes the +127 baseline; consider moving to an env var BASELINE_PAYMENTS for tunability.

PlatformAccessScreen handleTierPick sets checkoutLoading then awaits startStripeCheckout (which redirects on success). On Edge Function error, we log + reset checkoutLoading but don't surface a user-visible toast — a silent failure could confuse users. Minor UX improvement.
